description: Source file implementing ASN.1 message structures and encoding/decoding methods for BCCH-BCH messages in 3GPP NR RRC, including classes for MIB, BCCH-BCH message types, and related configurations.

classes.name: bcch_bch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the BCCH-BCH message structure with packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: bcch_bch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the choice of message type within BCCH-BCH message, supporting MIB and message class extension.

classes.name: mib_s
classes.description: Represents the MIB structure with various configuration parameters and JSON serialization.

classes.name: pdcch_cfg_sib1_s
classes.description: Represents the PDCCH-ConfigSIB1 ASN.1 sequence with packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the object into bit stream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the object from bit stream.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the object into JSON format.

methods.name: set_mib
methods.description: Sets the message type to MIB.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets the message type to message class extension.
